counts_note: Positive model executions are distinct explored schedules, not additional Rust test cases. Each of13 positive test processes completed; each of14 negative test processes deliberately failed with its exact expected invariant marker.
coverage: Admission freezes before handoff; issued writers drain
Owner and staged data publish together
Revocation, cancellation, state/registry/owner changes reject stale worker adoption
Origin-bound cancellation rejects foreign colliding job nonce
Async completion adoption rejects unload/reload (abstract result, no IO backend)
Slot generations reject ABA; reduced exhausted counter retires
Immutable Arc reader survives slot removal; single final drop
limitations: Abstract state machines; no proof of H4/H6 implementation or JVM synchronization.
READY queue and async IO adoption are prospective obligations, not implemented engine features.
Only configured bounded schedules and Loom-supported memory behaviors are checked.
Tool hashes cover listed binaries, not every MSVC linker/SDK/system library or environment input.
No full H4/H6 refinement proof; models check reduced contracts rather than source execution.
No liveness, fairness, starvation, JVM safepoints/aliases, multi-job queues, complete dependency graph, reverse materialization/rollback or live server qualification.
Reclamation negative control uses safe logical sentinel, not actual use-after-free.
